Package au.csiro.pathling.terminology.local.index

Class ConceptMapIndex

java.lang.Object
au.csiro.pathling.terminology.local.index.ConceptMapIndex
public final class ConceptMapIndex extends Object
The concept map index: the mappings of the imported FHIR ConceptMaps, keyed by canonical URL and addressable in both directions. It backs local translate for explicit concept maps.

Only the catalogue of maps is read up front, from the store manifest. The mappings of a map are read the first time it is translated through, and only those of the version that answers: the latest, where the store holds several. They are then held for the life of the index in a compact form, with each distinct code stored once as UTF-8 bytes and each mapping as a handful of integers, so that a map of millions of mappings fits in a modest heap, both while it is read and afterwards.

Author:
John Grimes

  • Method Details

    • load

      @Nonnull public static ConceptMapIndex load(@Nonnull TerminologyStoreReader reader, @Nonnull VersionResolver versionResolver)
      Opens the concept map index over a store, reading the catalogue of imported maps from the manifest. No mappings are read until a map is first translated through.
      Parameters:
      reader - the store reader, retained to read the mappings of each map on first use
      versionResolver - the resolver used to select the latest version of a map
      Returns:
      the index

    • translate

      @Nonnull public List<TerminologyService.Translation> translate(@Nonnull String conceptMapUrl, @Nonnull String system, @Nonnull String code, boolean reverse)
      Translates a coding through a concept map. Filtering to a target value set, when requested, is applied by the caller against the resolved value set membership, matching remote-mode behaviour.
      Parameters:
      conceptMapUrl - the canonical URL of the concept map
      system - the coding system
      code - the coding code
      reverse - whether to translate target to source instead of source to target
      Returns:
      the translations in the order the map lists them, empty if the map or the code is unknown
      Throws:
      AmbiguousVersionException - if the store holds several versions of the map and none of them is clearly the latest
